commercialPurpose: Build personal/editorial trust through a human author identity module instead of corporate logo proof.
purposeLayer: The proof cue tells readers who curates the content and why the publication feels credible.
anatomyLayer: Portrait or profile placeholder, short bio, signature mark, small badges or featured logos, and social follow row.
hierarchyLayer: Portrait first, bio statement second, signature/badge proof third, social follow fourth.
gridRhythmLayer: Compact vertical card or sidebar block with centered identity elements.
densityLimitLayer: Use one profile image, 1 short bio, 1-3 badges or credibility marks, and 3-6 social links.
originalityLayer: Learn author-as-proof logic; transform it for consultants, creators, chefs, educators, stylists, or founders.
usageRuleLayer: Use when personal credibility or curator voice matters more than logo-strip social proof.
layoutGesture: author identity proof card embedded in sidebar rail
compositionTension: human portrait softens dense content browsing
focalPath: portrait to bio to signature or badges to social icons
negativeSpaceShape: small centered halo inside a boxed widget
depthLayering: flat card with portrait crop and micro proof marks
moduleScaleVariation: medium portrait with tiny badges and icons
breakoutBehavior: can live as sidebar widget or trust band insert
antiCopyBoundary: Do not copy the exact portrait, signature graphic, badge pair, or social row styling.

hyperAccuracyReceipt.nonCopyBoundary: Do not copy the Pallas-style script logo, muted gold CTA treatment, right-sidebar widget order, image set, or exact editorial spacing.
